title: Longitudinal, Prospective, French, Multicenter Cohort Study on Pancreatic Radiofrequency
official: Longitudinal, Prospective, French, Multicenter Cohort Study on Pancreatic Radiofrequency
summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate the oncological efficacy of pancreatic radiofrequency by the objective response rate (complete and partial responses according to RECIST 1.1.), 5 years after the end of treatment.
sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
